WidgetHome.ctaText: Want this on your own wines?

features.title: How the recommendation works
features.lead: Four things every shopper gets, whether your shop lists thirty wines or thousands.
features.languageText: This shopper wrote in Spanish on a French shop. Wineater understood the request and answered with the shop's own wines, described in the shop's language.
features.languageAlt: Intermarché wine widget. A shopper typed a Spanish request for a red wine to go with roast lamb. Four red wines from the shop are shown with prices and French labels.
features.reasonTitle: Every wine comes with its reason
features.reasonText: Each of the four picks has a one- or two-sentence explanation written for that request. On desktop it appears when the shopper hovers over the card.
features.reasonAlt: Brice & Burnett wine widget. After a German request for a strong red wine for a braai, hovering over a wine card shows why it was picked: exceptional value, dark berry fruit and spice that suit grilled food.
features.similarText: Every wine card has a Similar wines button. It returns four more wines close in taste and food pairing, taken from the same catalog.
features.similarAlt: Brice & Burnett wine widget after clicking Similar wines on a Bordeaux red. The search box shows the reference wine and four similar red wines are listed with prices.
features.speedTitle: Same speed on any catalog size
features.speedText: From a short wine list to thousands of wines, answers take a few seconds.
features.speedNote: Median of 3-4 searches per catalog. Not tested above {max} wines.
features.speedChart: Median answer time in seconds, by catalog size

HowItWorks.title: Send your wine list. We do the rest.
HowItWorks.lead: Shoppers describe what they want in their own words and get four wines from your catalog, each with a short reason.
HowItWorks.step1Text: Send your wine list as a CSV or product feed, or connect the API. It takes less than a day.
HowItWorks.step2Text: Our team configures Wineater on your inventory within 24 hours.
HowItWorks.step3Text: A QR code, a widget or an API link. You choose how shoppers reach it.
HowItWorks.qrDesc: Print it and place it at tables or near the wine shelves. Customers scan it, with no app to download.
HowItWorks.widgetDesc: One script tag on your wine pages. It matches your store's branding and recommends only from your catalog.
HowItWorks.apiDesc: Connect Wineater to your own search or recommendation engine. Full white-label, with inventory kept in sync.
HowItWorks.startNote: Start with a free month. No credit card.
